subject: ExaClient: new optional args + deep()
body: search(): start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), include_domains, exclude_domains, include_text, exclude_text, search_type, summary {query, schema}, max_age_hours. contents(): summary, max_age_hours, subpages, subpage_target. deep(query, output_schema, ...) returns the whole response; result at output.content. Existing calls send identical bodies, so caches still hit. From Exa's spec: includeText/excludeText and livecrawl are deprecated, findSimilar is deprecated, category enum is company/publication/news/personal site/financial report/people.
